name: Polymorphic Entity
description:
Asleep within the coils of Shesha, floating on the Cosmic Ocean, Lord Vishnu lies undisturbed by dreams, until … Om, Brahma springs from Vishnu’s navel and creation begins.

Mahavishnu, the supreme and original Creator, floats on the Causal Ocean creating multiple dimensions of Vishnus asleep in the coils of many Sheshas, as unlimited Brahmas create infinite realities.

Vishnu also lives in the heart of every living being. 

This collage is made from bits of bornfree.org.uk.

name: When art defines your name!
description:
The title itself defines the description. When art is not just about drawing on a plane canvas it's more about your feelings and emotions ie. and how much you connected to your artwork. The head in between represents my carved and bent emotions. All mixed up through all neural networks.
The name "Psybot" means the variant of a virus which cannot be easily destroyed because of a huge network.

name: Humachine Imaginarium
description:
Humachine Imaginarium was a collaboration between me, Ashna Sahir and the AI model GPT3. Through guided creation, we tried to find out what a text-only language model imagines - what does an AI imagine? It involved asking GPT3 to construct a scene from its imagination. The text was then used step by step by Ashna to draw the scene. A beautiful scene was created, and of particular interest were the last few lines where GPT3 reflects on the meaning of the creation, purpose of existence and its relation to the person collaborating.
This work is permanently exhibited at the esteemed AI Art Galler

name: Happy Place
description:
Happy Place portrays an Indian Queen sitting in front of a painting she adores, that reminds her of the serenity she seeks. At night she dreams of visiting that place to enjoy the wind and nature. As the loop continues, the women sitting in front of window now dreams of having a life of a Queen and wants to have an artwork behind her instead of a window that doesn't appeal her much.

description:
This is a glimpse into the creative process. An attempt to show what is going on in the artist's mind. The infinite possibilities when he or she stands in front of the blank canvas in the studio. Every color pick or a brush stroke presents a
fork in the road. The artist keeps exploring, having no idea where the road might lead him/her. Composing, constructing, deconstructing, and rebuilding; brushing,
smearing, covering, and erasing; trying to get to a place that feels right.

name: Mr. Fabulous
description:
At first glance (and there's usually not a second) Bill appears to be rather unremarkable; which is very often true. He's an average middle-class citizen, with a mediocre job, living an average middle-class life. Or so he would have you believe... 
 
When the sun settles and darkness envelops Sky City, Bill takes to the streets as the celebrated hero, Mr. Fabulous; sworn to protect his beloved city from the evils of intolerance, discrimination, and inequality.

name: Layers of life
description:
Original watercolor portrait edited and transformed into collage work. I have huge love for patterns and ornaments and often I use them in my paintings and works. Pattern is sort of meditation, repeating something brings piece to my mind while working. 
Here is a small illustration of personal view over Life subject. Every layer of fabric representing one of the experiences we felt. And ornaments on them represent details that marked that specific event.

name: Puzzle2 // Who is Who?
description: Two women are facing each other, but are unable to reach the other one because a third person is standing in between. In the background you see a complex structure and a few rays of sunlight. One of the women is supported by a male person, from whose direction a kind of water-skiing lizard comes, pulled by a speedboat visible below.

name: "Untitled #2", from "Slits in Depth" series (2020/ 2021)
description:
This is the second work from the series of 3D anaglyph images “Slits in Depth”. 
“Untitled #2” was created and edited during The Great Lockdown. It has five layers: four dynamic and one static.

The background layer (“Exteriors”) presents landscapes photographed during some of my walks in the forest. The middle layer (“Resistance Band”) was shot in my studio with artificial light. And the top three layers (“Interior #1”, “#2” and “#3”) depict geometric architectural details from the place I live.
